justification: AgentBuilder.java is a dependency hub: the file imports 129 types/static imports and defines many nested APIs (`Listener`, `Transformer`, `RedefinitionStrategy`, `TypeStrategy`, `PoolStrategy`, `InitializationStrategy`, `InjectionStrategy`, `LocationStrategy`, `FallbackStrategy`, `LambdaInstrumentationStrategy`, `Default`). It is referenced from 53 source files via `AgentBuilder.` usages, including 5 production files (`Advice.java`, `ClassReloadingStrategy.java`, `ClassFileLocator.java`, `ResettableClassFileTransformer.java`, `ByteBuddy.java`) and 48 tests, which is strong fan-in on top of the class’s heavy fan-out.
